title: Great product, but bad packaging
text: Great product, but bad packaging. First, let me say I am obsessed with Yeti’s rambler drink ware. I think they’re made really well. However, the copper Yeti rambler (10 oz) lowball I ordered arrived with small scratches on the copper paint due to zero protection in transit (packaged in an oversized bubble envelope inside a thin plastic bag). Moral of the story: don’t buy Yeti products from Amazon.
